_comment: Template for the Vapi POST /call/phone API body. Use this in Make.com's HTTP module when triggering a call.

assistant.firstMessage: Hello, I'm calling on behalf of {{PATIENT_NAME}} regarding a prescription refill. Am I speaking with someone who can help?

_make_module_notes: Body: JSON — fill in the template values from Google Sheets data and Claude's route decision
{{CALL_REASON}}              → from Claude tool output: doctor_call_notes or pharmacy_call_notes
{{DOCTOR_OR_PHARMACY_PHONE}} → Google Sheets column F (doctor) or G (pharmacy)
{{VAPI_PHONE_NUMBER_ID}}     → found in Vapi dashboard under Phone Numbers
